nodes.description: String state variable holding the base URI used to build token URIs.
Public string state variable with the token URI file extension ('.json').
Public mint price in wei (1 ether) required by mintFLEX.
Public maximum supply of FLEX tokens (1111).
Timestamp computed at deployment as block.timestamp + 7 days, gating withdraw.
Private owner address inherited from Ownable; controls onlyOwner functions.
Constructor setting base URI and self-minting token id 1 to msg.sender.
Internal view override returning the stored baseURI.
Payable mint function; picks a random gift recipient and forwards ETH to gift winner and commission address.
View function enumerating all token ids owned by an address.
Public view pseudo-random generator using keccak256 over block.timestamp, msg.sender, seed and salt.
Returns the metadata URI by concatenating baseURI, tokenId and baseExtension.
onlyOwner setter for baseURI.
onlyOwner setter for baseExtension.
onlyOwner function sending the whole contract balance to the owner, gated by supply or headStart.
Returns the current owner address and is used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, mint restriction, randomness and payouts.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for randomness, headStart and withdraw gating.
Low-level call forwarding giftValue ETH to a randomly selected token owner (external call, reentrancy risk).
Low-level call sending 15% of msg.value to a hardcoded commission address.
Low-level call transferring the full contract balance to msg.sender in withdraw.
Pseudo-random number derived from block.timestamp, msg.sender, seed and salt, predictable/manipulable on-chain.
State variable headStart initialized from the block.timestamp of deployment.
Arithmetic computing the gift amount (address(this).balance * 10 / 100 or msg.value * 10 / 100).
Local variable caching totalSupply() at the start of mintFLEX.
Local payable address selected as the random gift recipient.
Local uint256 holding the ETH amount to send to the gift recipient.
Constructor parameter with the initial base URI string.
Modulo parameter bounding the random number returned by randomNum.
Seed parameter mixed into the random hash in randomNum.
Salt parameter mixed into the random hash in randomNum.
Token id parameter used to build the token URI.
New base URI string passed to setBaseURI.
New base extension string passed to setBaseExtension.
Owner address queried by walletOfOwner.
Local variable holding balanceOf(_owner) used to size the returned array.
Local uint256 holding the computed pseudo-random modulo result.
Local variable caching totalSupply() inside withdraw for the headStart check.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the mint caller, validated against owner and minted to.
msg.sender is included in the keccak256 randomness input.
owner() logic compares _owner with _msgSender().
block.timestamp used as the primary randomness seed, a timestamp dependency.
headStart is assigned from block.timestamp at construction.
Timestamp read flows into the headStart state variable initialization.
maxSupply is read to enforce the supply cap in mintFLEX.
cost is read to validate msg.value in mintFLEX.
mintFLEX writes totalSupply() into the local supply variable.
mintFLEX branch controls whether giftValue arithmetic is executed.
supply drives the supply+1 == maxSupply branch selecting the gift amount.
Computed arithmetic result is stored into the giftValue local variable.
giftValue is the ETH amount passed to the external low-level call.
mintFLEX performs an external value call after minting, exposing reentrancy.
giftAddress is the untrusted recipient of the external value call.
randomNum result indexes ownerOf to derive the gift address.
mintFLEX performs a second external value call sending the commission.
withdraw forwards the full balance through a low-level call to msg.sender.
owner() returns the stored _owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier on setBaseURI checks _owner through owner().
onlyOwner modifier on setBaseExtension checks _owner through owner().
onlyOwner modifier on withdraw checks _owner through owner().
withdraw branch requires block.timestamp >= headStart or full supply.
Constructor calls setBaseURI during deployment.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
setBaseExtension writes the baseExtension state variable.
_baseURI reads the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI concatenates the stored baseURI.
tokenURI concatenates the stored baseExtension.
tokenURI consumes the tokenId parameter and validates _exists(tokenId).
walletOfOwner reads balanceOf and tokenOfOwnerByIndex for _owner.
walletOfOwner stores balanceOf(_owner) into ownerTokenCount.
randomNum computes pseudo-randomness from block.timestamp derived inputs.
randomNum stores the modulo result into the local num variable.
The keccak256 pseudo-random operation produces the num local variable.
External value call can re-enter mintFLEX before state is fully settled.
External value call in withdraw can re-enter withdraw.
Constructor parameter feeds the initial base URI configuration.
_mod parameter bounds the randomNum result.
_seed parameter is hashed inside randomNum.
_salt parameter is hashed inside randomNum.
tokenId parameter flows into tokenURI existence check and URI construction.
_newBaseURI parameter is assigned to baseURI.
_newBaseExtension parameter is assigned to baseExtension.
_owner parameter is used for balance and token enumeration.
withdraw caches totalSupply() into the local supply variable.
supply local feeds the withdraw supply == maxSupply gate.

normalization_plan.reason: Local supply is a temporary cache of totalSupply() used only inside mintFLEX.
giftAddress exists solely to be the recipient of the low-level value call.
giftValue exists solely as the value argument of the low-level gift call.
Constructor parameter used only to configure the contract during deployment.
Modulo parameter used only inside randomNum.
Seed parameter used only inside randomNum.
Salt parameter used only inside randomNum.
Token id parameter used only to build the token URI.
Input parameter assigned directly to the baseURI state variable.
Input parameter assigned directly to the baseExtension state variable.
Owner address parameter used only for enumeration in walletOfOwner.
Local size cache used only inside walletOfOwner.
Local num holds the result of the unsafe pseudo-random operation.
Local supply cache used only inside the withdraw guard.
